source_title: What Is A Payment Account Reserve
snippet_primary: "When you have a Payment account reserve on your account, a percentage of your earnings on orders are set aside and your sales aren't available for deposit until 45 days have passed from the date of the sale."
subject_exact: Etsy policy states Payment Account Reserve holds a percentage of earnings from orders; funds not available for deposit until 45 days from sale date
time_scope_raw: 45 days from date of sale (Payment Account Reserve hold)
local_qualifiers: Payment Account Reserve: percentage of earnings set aside (specific percentage not stated in snippet)
